    Testing¶

    Requires the oidc extra:

    uv add "rn-forge-auth[oidc]"

    rn_forge.auth.testing is not re-exported from rn_forge.auth — import it directly:

    from rn_forge.auth.testing import FakeOidcProvider

    rn_forge.auth.testing ¶

    An in-process OpenID Connect provider for tests.

    :class:FakeOidcProvider serves discovery, a key set with rotation, an authorization endpoint, a token endpoint, UserInfo and back-channel logout tokens on a loopback port. Nothing leaves the machine. Each field of :class:Faults switches one failure on.

    Requires the oidc extra. Not imported by :mod:rn_forge.auth; import this module directly.

    Example: >>> with FakeOidcProvider() as idp: ... idp.issuer.startswith("http://127.0.0.1:") True

    FakeOidcProvider(*, client_id='web-login', client_secret='fake-secret', redirect_uris=('http://127.0.0.1/callback',), user=None, tenant='tenant', id_token_ttl=300.0) ¶

    An OpenID Connect provider on 127.0.0.1 and an ephemeral port.

    The issuer is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<tenant>. The authorization endpoint approves user without a login page and redirects back with a single-use code; the token endpoint exchanges it, checking PKCE and the client's credentials. Use it as a context manager, or call :meth:start and :meth:close.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    client_id str

    The registered client.

    		 'web-login'
    client_secret str | None

    The client's secret, accepted as client_secret_post or HTTP Basic. None registers a public client.

    		 'fake-secret'
    redirect_uris Sequence[str]

    The registered redirect URIs.

    		 ('http://127.0.0.1/callback',)
    user Mapping[str, Any] | None

    The claims of the user the authorization endpoint approves; it must contain sub.

    		 None
    tenant str

    The issuer's path segment.

    		 'tenant'
    id_token_ttl float

    Seconds an ID token or an access token stays valid.

    		 300.0

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    faults

    The failure switches; assign :class:Faults or set fields.
    deny_authorization

    When true the authorization endpoint answers access_denied instead of approving.
    oauth2_only

    When true the provider behaves as a plain OAuth 2.0 server: the authorization endpoint accepts a request without the openid scope or a nonce, and the token response carries no ID token. The UserInfo endpoint then serves as the user endpoint.
    advertise_end_session

    Whether discovery lists end_session_endpoint.
    auth_age

    Seconds before each authorization request that the approved user is recorded as having authenticated; it sets the ID token's auth_time.
    requests list[RecordedRequest]

    Every request received, in order.
    issuer

    The issuer URL.
    jwks_url

    Where the key set is served.

    forged_key cached property ¶

    A private key the key set never lists.

    access_token(*, profile='rfc9068', audience='api://orders', subject=None, client_id=None, scope=None, ttl=300.0, **claims) ¶

    A signed JWT access token for bearer tests.

    rfc9068 carries typ: at+jwt and iss, exp, aud, sub, client_id, iat and jti. rfc7519 carries no typ and only iss, exp, aud, sub and iat. Extra claims override those; a claim set to None is omitted.

    close() ¶

    Stop serving and release the port.

    fetches(suffix) ¶

    How many requests had a path ending with suffix.

    logout_token(*, sid=None, sub=None, audience=None, ttl=120.0, **claims) ¶

    A back-channel logout token (OIDC Back-Channel Logout 1.0 §2.4).

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    sid str | None

    The session ID to end.

    		 None
    sub str | None

    The subject whose sessions end.

    		 None
    audience str | None

    The aud; defaults to the client.

    		 None
    ttl float

    Seconds until exp.

    		 120.0
    **claims Any

    Extra or overriding claims; None omits one.

    		 {}

    Raises:

    Type Description
    ValueError

    Neither sid nor sub is given.

    publish(kid, *, current=False) ¶

    Generate a key, list its public half in the key set under kid and return the private key. With current, new tokens are signed with it.

    rotate_key(*, retire_old=False) ¶

    Publish a new key, make it the signing key and return its kid.

    The old key stays in the key set unless retire_old is true.

    sign(claims, *, typ=None, kid=None, alg='RS256', key=None) ¶

    A token with exactly claims (None values omitted).

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    claims Mapping[str, Any]

    The payload.

    		 required
    typ str | None

    The typ header; None omits it.

    		 None
    kid str | None

    The kid header; defaults to the current signing key's.

    		 None
    alg str

    RS256, RS384, RS512 or none.

    		 'RS256'
    key RSAPrivateKey | None

    The private key to sign with; defaults to the one published under kid.

    		 None

    start() ¶

    Begin serving. Calling it again has no effect.

    Faults(response_iss=False, response_iss_missing=False, discovery_issuer=False, userinfo_sub_mismatch=False, userinfo_error=False, wrong_nonce=False, wrong_aud=False, wrong_azp=False, wrong_at_hash=False, expired=False, alg_none=False, unknown_kid=False) dataclass ¶

    Failure switches for :class:FakeOidcProvider. Each is off by default.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    response_iss bool

    The authorization response carries an iss parameter naming another issuer.
    response_iss_missing bool

    The authorization response carries no iss parameter, although discovery advertises it.
    discovery_issuer bool

    The discovery document names another issuer.
    userinfo_sub_mismatch bool

    UserInfo returns a sub that differs from the ID token's.
    userinfo_error bool

    UserInfo answers 500.
    wrong_nonce bool

    The ID token carries a different nonce.
    wrong_aud bool

    The ID token's aud is another client.
    wrong_azp bool

    The ID token's aud lists the client and another one, and azp names the other one.
    wrong_at_hash bool

    The ID token's at_hash is not the access token's hash.
    expired bool

    The ID token's exp is in the past.
    alg_none bool

    The ID token is unsigned (alg: none).
    unknown_kid bool

    The ID token is signed with a key the key set does not list, under a kid it does not list.
